note: Converted from delhi_master_final_geo.csv to live /data/delhi/points.json schema. rate=₹/sqft sale. No invented prices/coords. Live Delhi fields are lon,lat,type,deal,size,rate,date,src,bhk,soc,url,district,ward,area (NOT Bengaluru's corporation/zone). types: plot=0, floor=1 (builder floor + independent house), apartment=2 (apartment + DDA flat). Circle-rate rows included when price_per_sqft present (already Rs/sqm→Rs/sqft ÷10.764 in master) or converted from circle_rate_per_sqm; src labeled 'Delhi circle rates'. size=0 when unknown. district/ward/area indices from live areas.json parents when locality matched.
stackingWarning: Most priced rows share area-centroid coordinates (geo_precision=area). Only 4 points have society-level precision. Expect heavy pin stacking unless you filter to delhi_society_pins.csv or enable societies.json aggregation (manifest.societies=true).
